Thanks for the ping, Steph. I reviewed FP_retention_matrix_v1.xlsx and sketched a product response below.

What we can support today (as of platform v4.2):
- Per-tenant TTL at the model invocation level (global default + override per-tenant via admin API). This applies to generated outputs and embeddings.
- Admin API to set a default archive policy (cold / hot) per workspace.

Gaps / near-term (Q2 roadmap item):
- Data-type granularity (logs vs user content vs embeddings): requires schema tagging across our storage tier and a small metadata index to surface per-asset policies. Target: Q2 release but needs an INF ticket (we should link).
- EU-only at-rest guarantee: we already support region pinning for runtime (compute) on Dedicated and Private, but storage residency for hosted tenants is currently region-preferred, not strictly-guaranteed. We can offer contractual residency in a Dedicated/Private deployment; for Hosted, we have to implement strict regional routing + storage partitions — estimate Q3 for hosted offering with a compliance SLA.

TL;DR: feasible but non-trivial. Engineering notes below.

1) Per-tenant + data-type TTLs:
- Implementation: add a policy layer in front of object store writes. Each object gets a small metadata envelope (tenant_id, data_class, ttl_policy_id). A background lifecycle manager enforces expiry and triggers deletion flows. Work is needed in the SDKs, admin API, and the lifecycle workers.
- Effort: small-medium; we can do an initial MVP in ~8 engineer-weeks (two engineers + infra support). Target: end of Q2 if we prioritize.

2) EU-only residency + backup purge hooks:
- Current backup architecture: snapshots are geo-replicated to ensure DR and faster restores. To offer strict EU-only guarantees we'd need to partition backups by region and optionally retain region-restricted backup copies only. That means additional storage/ops complexity and changes to our snapshot/restore tooling.
- Purge-from-backups SLA: we can implement a best-effort purge process but guaranteeing immediate purge from all historical snapshots is not realistic with current snapshot model; we can provide an SLA to delete future snapshots and to rotate out affected historical snapshots within a defined window (e.g., 90-180 days) while offering shorter windows for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Effort: medium-large. I opened INF-2147 to track storage partitioning / backup policy work.

Attachments: regional-storage-tech-spec.pdf (design notes)
Jira: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-2147

Recommendation: Offer FinPartners a staged approach in contract:
A) Short-term (hosted): per-tenant TTL (MVP) + admin API — Q2 target; offer best-effort regional preference for EU storage and commit to roadmap for strict residency.
B) Mid-term (Q3): hosted strict regional storage + backup partitioning and a contractual SLA for backup purge (90-day window).
C) If FinPartners requires immediate strict residency + tight purge SLA, recommend Dedicated or Private deployment as an expedited path.

Happy to discuss technical tradeoffs on a call.

—Aditya
